preconditions.description: No additional preconditions beyond Python's str type for both arguments.

postconditions.expression: all(c1.count(c.lower()) == c2.count(c.lower()) for c in set(c1.lower() + c2.lower()))
postconditions.description: The two input strings are anagrams if and only if every character in the combined lowercase versions of both strings has the same count in each string individually. This means the multiset of characters (case-insensitive) in both strings must be identical.
